messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they say "零假設檢定的標準差" which might mean "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? They provide sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, population mean 98.6. They want to compute something. Possibly they want to compute the standard error or the t-statistic? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" could be interpreted as "standard deviation under the null hypothesis" which is the standard error of the mean: sigma/sqrt(n). But they gave sample std dev 1.4, so maybe they want to compute the standard error: 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2215. Or maybe they want to compute the t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / (1.4 / sqrt(40)) = (-0.4) / 0.2215 = -1.805. Then compute p-value. The user specifically says "以得到人口平均值為98.6" meaning "to get population mean 98.6". So they want to test H0: mu = 98.6 vs Ha: mu != 98.6. They want to compute the standard deviation for the null hypothesis test? That would be the standard error. So answer: standard error = 1.4 / sqrt(40) ≈ 0.2215. Then t-statistic = (98.2 - 98.6) / 0.2215 ≈ -1.805. Then p-value for two-tailed test with df=39: p = 2 * (1 - CDF_t(|t|)). We can approximate using t distribution. For t=1.805, df=39, p ~ 0.079. Let's approximate: t=1.805, df=39, p ~ 0.079. So p-value ~ 0.079. So we fail to reject at alpha=0.05. So answer: standard error ~0.2215, t-statistic ~-1.805, p-value ~0.079. Provide explanation.
